preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
Each test case must have an even length n between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in '01' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length n and consist only of characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if not possible else stdout.startswith('YES')
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to construct the sequences, output 'NO'; otherwise, output 'YES'.

postconditions.expression: len(a) == n and len(b) == n and all(a[i] == b[i] if s[i] == '1' else a[i] != b[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The sequences a and b must have length n and satisfy the conditions based on the characters of s.
Both sequences a and b must be balanced bracket sequences.
